column1: SemaFailBench — Structured Literature Review Workbook (Third-Pass / Corrected)
Scope: This is a second-pass, rigorously re-verified and expanded structured literature
review (50 papers), building on and correcting a first-pass 32-paper version. It should
be described as a "structured literature review" — not a formal systematic literature
review — per the accuracy requirements governing this project.
Every entry's Authors/Year/Venue/URL were checked against arXiv abstract pages, ACL
Anthology, ACM Digital Library, IEEE Xplore/ASE conference records, official conference
proceedings pages, or the Semantic Scholar Graph API. Where a detail could not be
confirmed, the cell reads 'Could not verify', 'Not reported', or 'Not applicable' rather
than being guessed.
Second-pass corrections: nine first-pass entries with unresolved author fields
(P009, P013, P016, P019, P022, P023, P025, P030, P032) were re-verified and corrected.
One venue claim (P022, 'Findings of ACL 2026') surfaced by an AI-generated search
summary could NOT be corroborated against the primary source and was reverted to
'arXiv preprint' — an explicit example of the conservative, do-not-invent standard
applied throughout. A second claim (P023, 'IEEE Cloud Summit 2026') WAS independently
confirmed from the primary source text and retained/strengthened.
Eighteen new papers (P033-P050) were added in the second pass to strengthen coverage of:
LLM serving systems (vLLM/PagedAttention, SGLang), continuous/production ML monitoring,
RAG/retrieval failure taxonomies, model-routing literature, quantization-safety
convergent evidence, reasoning-stability scoring, and ACL-specific coverage (prompt
sensitivity, structured-output RL, multilingual evaluation, instruction-following
robustness). Decoding-configuration-drift-as-a-deployment-fault remains the weakest-
covered theme even after a dedicated second search — disclosed explicitly rather than
papered over (see Gap Summary and Search Log).
Sheets:
Literature Matrix       — the 50-paper matrix (30 columns per spec + 2 added columns)
Gap Summary             — per-research-area synthesis (19 areas, evidence-cited)
Search Log              — 28 queries executed across the first two passes, with dates/outcomes
Closest Competitors     — 15 papers assessed against 12 competitor-analysis questions
Foundational Papers     — top 20 papers ranked by importance, with citation guidance
ACL Novelty Assessment  — 'why isn't this just X?' for HELM, IFEval, RETAIN, CAIN,
PromptRobust, JSONSchemaBench, Watson, AgentOps,
FormatSpread, ChatBug, Design Principles, Q-resafe, ProSA
Phase A Change Log     — third-pass correction log (new sheet)
Known coverage gaps disclosed (see Gap Summary and Search Log for full detail):
decoding-configuration-drift-as-a-deployment-fault and benign/accidental model-routing
or checkpoint-version-mismatch faults remain the two weakest-covered fault categories
after two dedicated search passes — this is disclosed because it directly supports
(rather than undermines) SemaFailBench's novelty claim.
Third-pass corrections (this file):
Applied directly to the Literature Matrix, Closest Competitors, Foundational Papers,
and ACL Novelty Assessment sheets in this workbook: (1) P004 author name corrected
from 'Wanqing Ma' to 'Wanqin Ma'; (2) full text of P004, P020, P021, P024, P026, P031,
P035, P038, P040, P046 inspected and Status confirmed 'Read' with Method/Experiments/
Limitations detail added; (3) P033 and P034 kept as 'Reading' because their full
experimental model rosters were not inspected — bibliographic and method-level detail
is complete, but this is disclosed as an unresolved field, not silently upgraded;
(4) all instances of fixed fault-count language ('11 fault types' / '11 fault
categories') replaced with cautious non-numeric wording; (5) P024 and P046 confirmed
as fully peer-reviewed, published Findings papers and are not listed among
weaker-than-peer-reviewed evidence anywhere in this workbook; (6) every 2026-dated
paper (P022, P023, P035, P050) re-labeled with one of four explicit publication-status
tiers: arXiv preprint only / accepted, proceedings pending / workshop publication /
peer-reviewed and officially published. See the Phase A Change Log sheet for the full,
itemized list of edits with cell-level justification.
Scope note: per explicit task instruction, this third pass did NOT repeat the broad
literature audit or conduct another broad literature search. Corrections were limited
to full-text verification of 12 previously abstract-level-only essential papers,
author-name correction, fixed-fault-count language removal, 2026 publication-status
audit, and consistency edits to the Closest Competitors / Foundational Papers / ACL
Novelty Assessment sheets. All other Literature Matrix rows and the Gap Summary /
Search Log sheets are otherwise unchanged from the second pass.
